title: Thai Chicken Salad
description: A refreshing Thai-inspired salad made with juicy chicken, crunchy vegetables, and spicy Thai dressing.
instructions: 1. Chop the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces and season with salt and pepper.
2. Grill the chicken over medium-high heat until cooked through.
3. Chop the red bell pepper, cucumber, and tomato into small pieces.
4. In a large bowl, combine the chopped vegetables and cooked chicken.
5. Drizzle the Thai dressing over the top of the salad and toss to combine.
6. Serve the salad immediately and enjoy.
